ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a longitudinal-section structural schematic diagram of a flower, labeled A–K. The arrow for D points to the swollen chamber region at the base of the female reproductive structure of the flower; inside this region, several small bead-like structures can be seen, indicating the location of the ovules. Reasoning: In the pistil/carpel of a flower, the organ located at the base, swollen, and enclosing the ovules is called the ovary. Therefore, D represents the ovary.
